takes.text:
<Subject 1> = the older woman of <Picture 1>
<Subject 2> = the mirror reflection, identical except for a smile that arrives too early

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands alone before a tall mirror in an empty dance studio lined with mirrors, in a medium shot that holds both <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>. The camera pushes in at slow speed. At first everything is normal; then <Subject 2> smiles a little too early and lifts one hand before <Subject 1> does. <Subject 2> places both hands against the inside of the glass and climbs out in one smooth, impossible motion, as though the mirror were a flexible membrane, and steps fully into the room while <Subject 1> freezes. <Subject 2> calmly raises one hand to the jaw of <Subject 1> and, with controlled unnatural strength, opens the mouth far wider than a human mouth can open. <Subject 2> leans forward and slides head-first into the open mouth, shoulders and torso following in one continuous movement. <Subject 1> sways but stays standing, slowly closes their mouth and straightens. In the final moment <Subject 1> lifts their head wearing the exact unnerving smile of <Subject 2>, and the new reflection lags a full second behind every movement.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, light breathing, soft glass-contact sounds at the mirror surface, and a smooth, unnatural sliding sound.
